rows.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 A daan6 hai6 B
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that B is true in spite of A.

example.english: Despite the rain today, we’re still going hiking.
example.traditional: 雖然今日落雨，但係我哋照樣去行山。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ziu3 joeng6 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this when the concession has an even-if or stronger hypothetical flavour rather than simply stating an existing fact.

example.english: Despite having to queue for two hours, I’ll still wait for you.
example.traditional: 就算要排兩個鐘，我都會等你。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 jiu3 paai4 loeng5 go3 zung1 ngo5 dou1 wui5 dang2 nei5

rows.note: Use this formal written construction for a compact equivalent of notwithstanding A.

example.english: Despite facing numerous difficulties, the project was completed on schedule.
example.traditional: 儘管面對重重困難，計劃仍然如期完成。
example.jyutping: zeon6 gun2 min6 deoi3 cung4 cung4 kwan3 naan4 gai3 waak6 jing4 jin4 jyu4 kei4 jyun4 sing4
